description: Look up one shop by URL or bare domain. www, scheme, port, and path are removed. Returns listed, certified (the R4 seal from a Mystery test or a verified bot report), canBuy, actions (search, book, order), abortReasons (not_listed, not_included, below_r3, no_order), and a short reason, plus level, purchaseReady when that field is already on the listing, the purchase path (protocol, endpoint when known, guestCheckout), known blockers from the Ready4Bots test (step and cause only), lastTestedAt, and botReport success and abort counts. canBuy is true only when the shop is listed at R3 or R4 and is certified or publishes an order action. Purchase-attempt counts are used when that table exists. Otherwise existing bot-board counts are used. An unknown domain returns found false and says to call check_website. This lookup does not run a check and does not award a level or the seal.

domain.description: Bare domain, if url is omitted.

url.description: Shop URL. www, scheme, port, and path are removed.
